text:
Bea - CSM: Quick heads-up about Lumina Labs. They're seeing higher tail-latency during peak chat and want to cut unit cost before renewal. Traffic: mostly short queries (median ~18 tokens) plus a small % of long doc-extract jobs (seq 250+). Want low-risk options.

Rohit - ML Eng: Sounds like a split-by-length + compact quant pilot. Short interactive -> compact-int8 (or int4 if quality holds); long jobs -> standard fp16 or dedicated. Need to validate numeric accuracy and entity extraction on their doc prompts.

Sanna - SuccessOps: Recommend an initial canary: 3% short-path to gpt-compact-int8-v1, prefix caching for repeated confirmations, watchlist of 40 critical extraction templates. Ramp rules + rollback included.

Ivy - SRE: Safety guards: only run 09:00-17:00 customer local for first 48h. Auto-rollback if p95 > baseline * 1.15 for 10m or extraction-failure-rate >= 0.6%. Notify customer SRE channel immediately on rollback.

Rohit - ML Eng: I'll run a 500-sample regression on their canonical prompts (chat + doc extractions). Expect ~25-30% per-token speedup on short calls; cost drop ~15-20% for short-path. Risk: numeric/entity misses on rare edge cases.

Sanna - SuccessOps: Acceptance criteria for renewal pitch: either cost decrease >=15% OR p95 improvement >=12% with <=0.8% extraction-failure uplift. If met, package as "renewal optimization" credit.

Bea - CSM: Can you paste the dry-run route config we push to Console? I'll loop in Lumina for opt-in window.

Rohit - ML Eng: Dry-run snippet (push as preview first):

```
route_policies:
  - name: lumina-short-quant-canary
    match: "request.client == 'lumina' && request.tokens <= 48 && rand() < 0.03"
    target_model: gpt-compact-int8-v1
    fallback: gpt-compact-fp16-v1
    latency_slo_ms: 450
    metrics: [p95, extraction_failure_rate, embedding_similarity]
  - name: lumina-long-path
    match: "request.client == 'lumina' && request.tokens > 48"
    target_model: gpt-standard-fp16-v2
    fallback: gpt-standard-fp16-v2
slo_guards:
  p95_multiplier: 1.15
  extraction_failure_threshold_pct: 0.6
monitoring:
  sample_size: 500
  lookback_minutes: 60
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_seconds: 300
```

ops-bot: created canary workspace '/canaries/4790016000-lumina-preview' (dry-run). Alerts: '/alerts/4790016000'. Runbook: '/runbooks/lumina-quant-rollback'.

Ivy - SRE: Also propose a dynamic ramp: if error_rate < 0.4% and p95 < 500ms for two consecutive 10m windows, increase to 15% off-peak for 6h. Roll back if thresholds breach.

Rohit - ML Eng: I'll post the 500-sample regression + a 50-manual-spotcheck summary by EOD tomorrow.

Sanna - SuccessOps: I'll draft a one-pager for Lumina SREs with rollback steps and a short FAQ. Schedule a 30m ops sync once dry-run is ready.

Bea - CSM: Great. Action items: Rohit -> regression + spot-check; Sanna -> one-pager + sync; Ivy -> alerts + ramp policy; Bea -> customer coordination. Will update when Lumina confirms opt-in. :thumbsup:
